passages.title: Library Notice
passages.text: Library users: Please ensure all books are returned to the desk before you leave. If you need to renew a book, you must do so at least two days before the due date. Thank you.

passages.title: Science Lab Rule
passages.text: Students are reminded that eating and drinking are strictly forbidden in the science laboratory. Please leave all bags and coats in the lockers provided in the hallway before entering.

passages.title: Computer Room Update
passages.text: The computer room will be closed for maintenance all day on Tuesday. Students who need to print assignments should use the printers in the main library instead.

passages.title: Lost Property
passages.text: A blue sports bag was found in the gym changing rooms yesterday. If it belongs to you, please collect it from the school office. You will need to describe the contents to claim it.

passages.title: Drama Club
passages.text: The Drama Club meeting scheduled for Thursday has been moved to Friday at 4 p.m. in the assembly hall. Please check the noticeboard for the updated rehearsal schedule.

questions.question: What must students do if they want to keep their library book for longer?
questions.explanation: The text states you must renew at least two days before the due date.
options: a) Ask the librarian to keep it for them.
b) Return it to the desk immediately.
c) Renew it before the due date.

questions.question: Where should students put their personal belongings before going into the lab?
questions.explanation: The text instructs students to leave bags and coats in the hallway lockers.

questions.question: What should students do if they need to print something on Tuesday?
questions.explanation: The notice suggests using the printers in the main library because the computer room is closed.
options: a) Go to the main library.
c) Ask a teacher for help.

questions.question: How can a student get their lost bag back?
questions.explanation: The text says you must describe the contents to claim the bag at the office.
options: a) By saying what is inside the bag.
b) By leaving a note at the gym.
c) By showing their student ID.

questions.question: What has changed about the Drama Club meeting?
questions.explanation: The meeting day has been moved from Thursday to Friday.
options: a) The time of the meeting.
b) The day of the meeting.
c) The location of the meeting.
